assets.prompt: Create one production sprite atlas for an original detailed 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG enemy, the Mirrorwing Moon Moth. Truly transparent background. A 2 by 2 equal-cell atlas, requested 1536x1536 PNG. One SAME enemy in exactly four isolated poses: top left idle hovering, top right gathering a paired moon bolt, bottom left releasing two moon bolts towards the LEFT (do NOT draw the projectiles), bottom right recoiling from a hit. Huge clean transparent gutters, at least 100 px between silhouettes, nothing crosses cell boundaries. Each frame complete with both antennae, all wings and legs. Side-view three-quarter facing LEFT, enemy lives on the right of a side-view battle. Creature has elegant large indigo/lilac moth wings with pale silver moon eye-patterns, faceted turquoise core in a small armored insect body, two bright eyes, ribbon-like tail appendages. Non-human mooncourt adversary, no humanoid person, no text, no labels, no frame borders, no UI, no scenery, no shadow or floor. Detailed crisp hand-placed looking pixel clusters, deliberate dark outlines, limited vivid indigo/teal/silver palette, opaque colored pixels against transparent alpha, sharp shapes not blurry painting. Consistent body/wing size, camera, lighting and identity across the four frames. Make each creature fill about 70% of its own cell with ample breathing room. Dedicated runtime enemy sprites, not a concept comparison sheet.

No text, labels, frame borders, UI, scenery, background, floor or cast shadow. Detailed crisp pixel clusters, deliberate hard dark outlines, limited slate/forest-green/mint/gold palette, clear stone versus bark material texture, opaque colored pixels with real transparent alpha. Sharp pixel art, no blurry painting, no 3D render. Same dimensions and stone mask and crystal position across all frames, consistent camera and light. Full body occupies about 70% of each equal square cell. Dedicated runtime enemy atlas, not a comparison concept sheet.

Create one dedicated transparent PNG inventory-icon atlas for an original detailed pixel-art fantasy mage game. Requested image size 1536x1536. Exactly four large independent icons in 2 by 2 equal square cells with generous transparent gutters, isolated objects, no text, no frame or cell borders, no UI, no scenery, no shadows on a floor. Top left: Frost Arrow sigil, pale blue long crystal arrowhead suspended over an indigo parchment strip with a small silver water rune. Top right: Gale Blades sigil, a pair of jade green crescent wind blades circling a small silver rune medallion. Bottom left: Steam Detonation sigil, an ornate copper-and-ivory spell tablet with a hot amber center and rising white teal-edged vapor curls, no potion bottle. Bottom right: Ember Vortex sigil, ruby and gold spiral spell wheel with several orange flame tongues and dark jade wind ribbons. Shared detailed 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG icon language, dark purple outlines, sharp clustered pixels, bold distinctive silhouettes and rich but controlled shading, readable at roughly 48 to 96 screen pixels. Full icon stays within its own equal cell, wide clean empty margins. Four different spell items, no duplicates. Truly transparent alpha outside the opaque painted pixels, no checkerboard baked in, no soft glow leaking outside sprites. Not a concept sheet and not a screenshot, a dedicated source atlas for runtime use.
